message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, and cult‑favorite horror films across various sub‑genres. Pick whatever feels right for your mood!

| # | Title | Year | Sub‑Genre | Why It Stands Out |
|---|-------|------|-----------|--------------------|
| 1 | **Psycho** | 1960 | Psychological Thriller | Hitchcock’s masterclass in suspense; the shower scene is legendary. |
| 2 | **The Shining** | 1980 | Supernatural / Psychological | Kubrick’s eerie adaptation of Stephen King’s novel; haunting visuals & Jack Nicholson’s iconic performance. |
| 3 | **Halloween** | 1978 | Slasher | John Carpenter’s seminal slasher film that introduced Michael Myers; simple yet terrifying. |
| 4 | **The Exorcist** | 1973 | Paranormal / Religious Horror | One of the most controversial and chilling exorcism stories ever told. |
| 5 | **Hereditary** | 2018 | Psychological / Supernatural | A modern masterpiece that blends family drama with creeping dread. |
| 6 | **Get Out** | 2017 | Social Commentary / Psychological | Jordan Peele’s sharp satire wrapped in a tense thriller. |
| 7 | **A Quiet Place** | 2018 | Survival / Sci‑Fi Horror | Silence is survival; the tension is palpable. |
| 8 | **It Follows** | 2014 | Modern Folk Horror | An original concept where a curse follows you at a walking pace. |
| 9 | **Midsommar** | 2019 | Folk Horror | Daylight horror that turns a pastoral festival into a nightmare. |
|10 | **The Babadook** | 2014 | Psychological / Supernatural | A mother‑child story that becomes a metaphor for grief. |
|11 | **The Ring** | 2002 | Supernatural / Mystery | A cursed videotape that brings death; a modern retelling of a Japanese classic. |
|12 | **Paranormal Activity** | 2007 | Found Footage | Low‑budget film that uses shaky camera work to create genuine fear. |
|13 | **The Cabin in the Woods** | 2012 | Meta‑Horror | A twist on the cabin‑in‑the‑woods trope that deconstructs genre expectations. |
|14 | **Suspiria** | 1977 | Gothic / Supernatural | Dario Argento’s visually stunning, hypnotic horror. |
|15 | **The Witch** | 2015 | Historical / Supernatural | A slow‑burning, atmospheric tale set in 1630s New England. |

Feel free to let me know if you’d like recommendations tailored to a particular era, sub‑genre, or rating!
